description: One row per missing item, grouped by archetype. Computed at run time by comparing the profile against each archetype's stated requirements, so changing the German level or answering a question changes these rows. The programmes named are real and were link-checked on 2026-09-22; each row carries the url and the date it was checked. Illustrative only: it is not advice, it states no verdict on equivalence, it names no prices and promises no outcomes.

item.note: What is missing. Real certificates and procedures may be named factually; none of them is invented.

why.note: Why it matters for that archetype, not in general.

typical_duration.note: A range, hedged. Empty where the provider states none or where no figure can be stood behind.

next_step.note: One step. Where an authority decides, the step is to ask the authority.

synthetic.note: The comparison is invented demo data. The procedures named in it are not.

provider.note: The body or company that actually runs it. Empty where the row names no programme.

caveat.note: Where an entry is one chamber's offer, one Land's procedure, a statute rather than a course, or a private vendor certificate, it says so here. Never imply one path per profession.

url.note: The programme page. Empty where no link applies, as with a licence conversion handled by a local office.

url_checked_on.note: The date the url was fetched and returned 200.

standing_caveat: Illustrative only. Requirements are set by the competent authority and vary by Bundesland: check your own case at anerkennung-in-deutschland.de. Nothing here states that any particular person qualifies for anything, and no fees are recorded.
